observed_via: pytest TestClient with OpenTelemetry console exporters; Docker/Grafana were unavailable

exception.message: day is out of range for month

root_cause: The express delivery estimate used datetime.replace(day=placed_at.day + 2). The seeded express order was placed on August 31, so the requested day 33 is invalid.
fix: Add timedelta(days=2) to the order timestamp, which correctly rolls over month boundaries.
